svg.text: Data flow: .db file → JSON response
Where our patches change behavior. Green outline = new path; everything else is original.
File open + header read
worldVersion, netTime, myId, nextUid, numZdos
Stream every ZDO (~8M) — single linear pass
For each: uint16 flags, Vector2s sector, Vector3 position, int32 prefab hash, [Vector3 rotation], typed bags
Dispatch by prefab hash → portal / bed / sign / tombstone / item stand / container / creature / structure / building
Container detected
store.containerIndices.add(...)
if (items != null) parseInventoryIntoTotals(...)
parseInventoryIntoTotals — PATCHED
Was: skipped if version > 105 (dropped 99% of containers)
Now: reads v106 — int32 worldLevel + byte pickedUp after customData
Capture per item: quality, crafterName, customData keys
On qual > 1M → quality overflow sample
On crafterName contains </> → server-issued count + add to issuer catalog
On customData has engravings.quality → engravings count
On Coins stack → containerCoinTotal accumulator → topCoinCaches if >0
After parse: ZdoFlatStore is the source of truth in memory
portalIndices · containerIndices · chestItemTotals · qualityOverflowSamples · serverIssuerCatalog · topCoinCaches · ...
Heatmaps (building / dropped / all) finalized for spatial queries
ContractBuilder + MetricsBuilder + AlertBuilder
Build typed contracts, compute portal clusters/zone budgets/hotspots
AlertBuilder also reads store for forensics alerts (PA4)
ApiServer routes — PATCHED + NEW
/economy enriched with category/tier per item + byCategory/byTier aggregates
+ /forensics/top-coin-caches · /server-issuers · /guild-gear
SPA fetches JSON, renders into Alpine reactive bindings
